format.step: {t: ms from start, dur: ms, strong: 0..1 low-freq motor, weak: 0..1 high-freq motor, left/right: 0..1 Xbox trigger motors (optional)}

intensity.note: final = step value * category * master, clamped 0..1. Priority when two effects overlap: damage > combat > suitup > movement > spider > world > suit > ui > continuous; a higher priority effect replaces the running one, the continuous layer resumes after it ends.

ui_tick.desc: focus move / slider step — a single crisp tick

ui_countdown_go.desc: GO — the one big UI thump

ui_map_open.desc: map rise-reveal ripple (matches the 1000 ms ring)

ui_suit_change.desc: palette wave on suit change (layer under the suit's own stinger haptic)

suit_mk1.desc: Mk I — clunky hydraulic, two heavy clanks

suit_mk2.desc: Mk II — quick servo buzz + crisp clamp

suit_mk85.desc: Mk 85 — nano flow swell then lock

suit_hulkbuster.desc: Hulkbuster — heavy clamp then a giant step

suit_ironspider.desc: Iron Spider — nano seal + four quick leg ticks

repulsor_shot.desc: repulsor shot — snap + recoil (right trigger kick)

repulsor_charged.desc: charged blast release — heavy (charge-up is continuous 'charge')

unibeam.desc: unibeam fire — sustained burn 0.8 s with flutter

boost.desc: boost kick — thump, then pressure fading

brake.desc: air brake — pressure pulse that eases off (the flight model brakes in 0.85 s)

hit_light.desc: taking a light hit (bullet) — use left/right trigger for the side it came from

hit_heavy.desc: taking a heavy hit (RPG / brute) — side via trigger

explosion_far.desc: explosion 40-300 m — delayed by distance / 340 m/s, low motor only

nano_flow.desc: nanotech spreading over the body — granular swell (1.2 s)

web_thwip.desc: web shot — thin crisp flick (weak motor only)

web_attach.desc: web attaches — the line goes taut

thruster_hum.desc: Iron Man thrusters. NOT a constant buzz: the hum follows throttle CHANGES and fades out when throttle is steady (attention decay), so hovering is silent in the hands.

formula.activity: A += (min(1, dThrottle * 2) - A) * (1 - exp(-dt / 0.08)) ; A decays to a floor of 0.15 over 800 ms steady
formula.update: every 50 ms (one 60 ms playEffect / start_joy_vibration block)

charge.desc: Repulsor / unibeam charge-up: weak motor ramps with charge, a tick at 50 % and a lock pulse at 100 %.

formula.events: at charge 0.5 play ui_tick; at 1.0 play suit_clamp, then hold weak 0.3 with 6 Hz flutter

web_tension.desc: Swinging / tether tension: creaks, not a buzz — short pulses at a rate that rises with tension.

formula.pulse: every 1 / (2 + 10 * tension) s play {dur 24, strong 0.15 * tension, weak 0.15 + 0.35 * tension}
formula.peak: at the bottom of a swing arc (max tension) add web_attach at 60 % gain
